title: 국제환규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:17:0:00017:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 17 (Handling of Defective International Money Orders)
(1) Where an exchange post office receives a request for correction of an international money order accident from the country in which the money order is to be paid, it shall notify the remitter of the fact.
(2) Where there is a defect in the entries of an international money order that has arrived, the exchange post office shall handle it as follows:
1. Where the payee can be identified, an International Money Order Accident Inquiry shall be sent to the payee;
2. Where the payee is unclear, an inquiry shall be made to the remitting country and the matter shall be handled according to the reply.
